_about: Public-domain Horace Bushnell (1802-1876, Congregational minister at Hartford, Connecticut) for the Word Hoard: Christian Nurture, The Vicarious Sacrifice, Sermons for the New Life, Christ and His Salvation and The Character of Jesus, clean from CCEL. His moral-influence view of the atonement departs from the Reformed divines on this list; he is here for his influence, and the shelf is Adam's to veto. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 12 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
